name: My Twin Romance
source:
You have been living a hard life all this while trying to find a job. One day, you were stopped by some delinquents on the road at night and was saved by a mysterious black-haired young man. With his offer, you attended a celebrities’ party.

When you were there, you helped a lady who spilled wine on herself and you were soon hired as a servant in that mansion. At that moment, you were thrilled as you’re finally employed, but waiting for you in that mansion are various unexpected things that will happen between you and a pair of twins with very unique personalities…!
translation:
你一直過著艱難的生活，努力尋找工作。某天夜裡，你在路上被幾個不良少年攔住，一名神秘的黑髮年輕男子救了你。在他的邀請下，你參加了一場名人派對。

在那裡，你幫助一名把酒灑在身上的女士，很快便被聘為那座豪宅的僕人。那一刻，你為終於找到工作而興奮，但等待你的還有許多意想不到的事情：你將與一對性格迥異的雙胞胎展開一段意想不到的故事……
